blocks.text: Five years ago every lantern on [[Port Vellen]]'s harbor front went out between one bell and the next. In the dark, the harbor archive burned and twelve people drowned in a flat calm. The town blames wreckers; the [[The Tidewardens|Tidewardens]] blame [[Kestrel Vane]]; Kestrel was provably at sea.

The Veiled Hand snuffed the lanterns with the same working that once called the sea — a rehearsal. The archive held the only surveyed map of the [[Undercrypt of Maro]]'s outer galleries. The twelve drowned were the surveyors' descendants, silenced by name.
